# deed_source (Data Source)

Reads a Deed source and its sync status by ID, or by `project` and `name` (any source the token can read). Useful for checks, for example that a connector synced recently and without errors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "deed_source" "github" {
  project = "homelab"
  name    = "github"
}

# Fail the run when the connector reports an error.
check "github_sync" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.deed_source.github.last_error == ""
    error_message = "GitHub sync failed: ${data.deed_source.github.last_error}"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Source ID (`src_…`).
- `name` (String) Source name (with `project`).
- `project` (String) Project name or ID (with `name`).

### Read-Only

- `config` (String) Provider configuration (JSON).
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the source runs and accepts data.
- `expected_interval_seconds` (Number) Expected data interval in seconds.
- `freshness` (String) Freshness: `fresh`, `stale`, `unknown` or `disabled`.
- `last_error` (String) Error of the last failed sync, empty after a success.
- `last_generation` (Number) Generation of the last committed snapshot.
- `last_heartbeat_at` (String) Last heartbeat from a push source (RFC 3339).
- `last_run_at` (String) Last sync start (RFC 3339), empty when never run.
- `last_success_at` (String) Last successful sync (RFC 3339), empty when never.
- `layer` (String) Fact layer the source writes.
- `next_run_at` (String) Next scheduled sync (RFC 3339).
- `policy` (String) Reconciliation policy (JSON).
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `provider_type` (String) Source provider (`github`, `terraform_state`, `push`, …).
- `pull` (Boolean) Whether Deed pulls from the source.
- `push` (Boolean) Whether programs push to the source.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether a sync is running now.
- `schedule_seconds` (Number) Pull interval in seconds (`0` = on demand).
- `secret_fields_set` (Set of String) Secret fields that have a stored value.
- `system` (Boolean) Whether Deed created the source for the project (`api`, `terraform`, `ui`, `overrides`).
